packageRules.description: Merge stable minor and patch updates once CI passes; 0.x minors can break, so they stay manual.
Majors wait for a checkbox in the Dependency Dashboard issue before a PR opens.
Automerged code lands in production, so give the registry time to pull compromised releases.
One version across package.json, Dockerfiles and CI.
One PR a week for every non-major update. It automerges only when no update in it is a 0.x minor.
CI tests the Go version in go.mod, which Renovate never bumps, so a new Go release in the build image needs a hand-made go.mod change.
